item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions: US Gov Virginia, US Gov Texas, US Gov Arizona, China North 3, and China East 3.

  • Source: Azure Updates
